---
title: "Network Diffusion"
subtitle: "Getting started with NetworkDynamics.jl via tvbo"
---

Replicates the [NetworkDynamics.jl Getting Started tutorial](https://juliadynamics.github.io/NetworkDynamics.jl/stable/generated/getting_started_with_network_dynamics/) — diffusion on an undirected network with 20 nodes. A single scalar state per node, antisymmetric diffusive coupling, and convergence to equilibrium.

## YAML Specification

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Code, Markdown
Code(filename="diffusion.yaml", language="yaml")
```

## Model Report

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("diffusion.yaml")
Markdown(exp.generate_report())
```

## Generated Julia Code

```{python}
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("diffusion.yaml")
Code(exp.render_code("networkdynamics"), language='julia')
```

## Run & Plot

```{python}
ts = exp.run(format="networkdynamics")
ts.plot()
```

## Results

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
print(f"Shape: {ts.data.shape}")
print(f"Time range: {ts.time[0]:.1f} – {ts.time[-1]:.1f}")
print(f"Final state std: {np.std(ts.data[-1, 0, :, 0]):.6f}")
print(f"(Should converge to ~0 as all nodes reach equilibrium)")
```

## Animate

```{python}
ani = ts.animate("v", format="dots")
ani.save("diffusion.gif", writer="pillow", fps=20)
```
